### Azure SQL

#### [Restart databases in Azure SQL DB via the Azure portal](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=577992)

Azure SQL - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

You can now restart or fail over databases directly from the Azure portal, including single databases, Hyperscale databases, and databases in elastic pools, without writing scripts against the Rest API or contacting support. Learn more.

#### [Extend immutability for PITR backups for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=579305)

Azure SQL - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

With this enhancement, you have the ability to lock your retention to the configured PITR retention, beyond the default 7 days of immutable backups that are already available.

#### [Support database-level managed identity (including FIC) in Create Database Scoped Credential T-SQL](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=577491)

Azure SQL - `public-preview` / `updated` - Medium impact

With database-level managed identity in Azure SQL Database, you can use a user-assigned managed identity for each database to query files in Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 through external tables and OPENROWSET.
